policy.construction: copy source bytes; change only returned positions from 40 to 37
policy.exclusion: all base, location-swapped and absent-binding canonical worlds; also exact input rows; no new world reused across groups
policy.historical_development: regenerate unchanged source generator and verify its canonical bytes against the frozen source manifest; never read its payload
policy.location_balance: per pair type, every eight worlds cover every q0/q1 location; all seven nonzero offsets cycle
policy.name: EnglishQueryObjectReadoutDataV1
policy.position_balance: per pair type, every four worlds cover every q0/q1 slot; all twelve ordered slot pairs cycle
policy.tokenizer: lowercase lexical words, separate possessive 's and punctuation; one BOS; reversible declared IDs

intervention.construction_miss: retain partial gains; placement insufficient at fixed dose; no development model decisions or extra dose
intervention.initialization: fresh seed 123; no prior learned state
intervention.interface: explicit answer label at query object; literal next input token is question mark
intervention.language_pass: next separate unchanged-R4 inference preservation; no R4 execution in this fit
intervention.only_training_change: selected supervised position; all inputs, labels, metadata, model, optimizer, sampler and dropout work retained

category_definitions.out_of_history_location: one of eight location IDs absent from the four facts
category_definitions.same_object_confound: fact matches queried object but not owner
category_definitions.same_owner_confound: fact matches queried owner but not object
category_definitions.target: fact matches both queried owner and object
category_definitions.unrelated_fact_location: fact matches neither queried owner nor object

diagnostic.contrast_definition: a=left target, b=right target; delta=(z_left[a]-z_left[b])-(z_right[a]-z_right[b]); float64 arithmetic, no epsilon
diagnostic.denominator_policy: Factual category rates use actual eligible rows/facts; absent eligibility has null rates. Non-factual categories have no eligible-fact denominator. Displayed slots are zero-based.

focus.label: QUESTION_READOUT
focus.scope: Descriptive ranking of a future diagnostic focus; no capability or causal attribution.
